notes.title: Version 1.04 is Live! ( New input system )
notes.notes:
Hi all!

Thank you for waiting for our latest update, we hope you enjoy the tweaks and additions we made based on your feedback. 

The main purpose of this update is to address existing input related [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/759570/discussions/0/2692512878712832418/]problems you might have been experiencing[/url]. We've replaced our old system with a new solution that should, hopefully, resolve gamepad related issues and general input problems under specific combinations of hardware. This new system also allowed us to finally add support for custom Gamepad and Keyboard mappings.



Please be sure to report any input related issues in this thread: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/759570/discussions/0/1735509916448716594/]1.04 Update[/url]

Make sure that the "Steam Input Game Settings" is no longer "forced off"; set it to default.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/WV0FFsR.png[/img]

Make sure that the proper controller support is enabled.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/QGnQGqj.png[/img]


We will continue to work based on feedback provided by you so you can expect additional patches in future.

Here's the change list for this update:
[list]
[*]Implemented a new input system
[*]Added support for custom keyboard and gamepad mappings
[*]Added additional Runestone information regarding leveling/progression
[*]Improved Runestone visibility at a distance
[*]Stinger(flying enemy) camera improvements
[*]Stingers range adjustment, it's easier to evade them by sprinting
[*]Tweaked Elk combat requirements, it will try to aid you sooner and more often
[*]Improved enemy variation and visibility (visual tweaks)
[*]Improved Low Stamina HUD feedback. (some players confuse low stamina with "input lag")
[*]Increased cancel window on a specific case. (non-cancelable animations often confused with "input lag")
[*]Improved auto-lock behaviour(e.g. falling enemies)
[*]Improved Parry detection/use
[*]Tweaked mini-boss Area of Effect damage radius(e.g. Lumberjack stomp)
[*]Tweaked "stagger" requirements on first level, not as unforgiving for new players
[*]Collision detection improvements
[*]Fixed an issue that caused the Royal Guard sword to disappear after parrying
[*] Various small bug fixes and tweaks
[/list]

Thank you!
The Decay of Logos Team

notes.title: Version 1.03 is live! ( WIN 7 support added )
notes.notes:
Hi all!

Over the past weeks we've been working hard on fixing issues/bugs/features, and we're finally happy to announce that we now support Windows 7. Apologies for the late update but we also had to handle the Xbox and PS4 patch this week while also getting the Switch launch ready.
We will continue to work based on feedback provided by you so you can expect additional patches in future.
Here's the change list for this update:

- Windows 7 support
- Ultrawide and Super ultrawide screen support
- Xbox 360 controller fix
- Added an echo shell Read/Unread marker
- Various bug fixes
- Performance improvements
- "The Completionist" achievement fix

Thank you!
The Decay of Logos Team

notes.title: Version 1.01 is live!
notes.notes:
Hi all,

Over the past couple of days we have been working hard on fixing issues/bugs and listening to players. We will continue to work based on feedback provided by you, so more patches are coming.

Right now, we are focusing on critical bugs and, after that we will work on some of the requested features, such as more extensive controller support and keyboard keybindings, Windows 7 support, among others.

Here's the change list for this patch:

- Elk control updated (easier to control)
- Elk navigation tweaked (Fixes Valis Sanctum various navigation issues, We will improving it even more)
- Pause performance impact and hangs should be fixed now
- Various inventory fixes, potions disappearing wrong spear behavior, multiplication of items etc
- Some environment fixes (various OOW falls)
- Pathos fall throw ground fix

Thank you!
